text:
rachel: Quick sync  Prospect (Aurelia Health) wants to move from POC to PO. They returned MSA/DPA with a Net60 ask and a mandatory HSM clause. Need fast alignment on prepay, signer, and DPA scope. tagging @priya @tomas

tomas: Procurement: For trials we normally require prepay or an approved PO. Net60 is OK only with credit approval. Also need remit address and tax id on PO.

priya: Legal: I skimmed redlines they dropped our audit protections and insisted on customer-managed HSM. For a short POC we should push back on HSM and offer KMS attestation instead. I can draft a 1-page POC addendum that limits audit to scoped attestation and sets data deletion (30 days).

finance-bot: Finance flag: Acceptable terms for POC: Net45 + 50% prepay. Net60 requires credit sign-off. Please collect billing contact and W-9.

haron: SE: POC runs on dedicated infra for ~2 weeks, perf target will be non-binding. Recommend "POC performance objective" median latency <200ms and include brief perf annex. Can't promise production SLO.

rachel: Proposed customer offer: 1) 1-page POC addendum (legal) 2) Payment: 50% prepay, remainder Net45 3) SLA: POC performance objective (non-binding) 4) E-sign allowed with PO attached. Any objections?

priya: No objections. I'll remove mandatory HSM for POC, keep KMS attestation language, and draft the addendum today.

tomas: I'll ask customer to send PO to procurement@redwood.example and collect remit/W-9.

rachel: Action items: @priya draft addendum; @haron provide perf text; @tomas collect PO and billing info. I'll own e-sign envelope once addendum is ready. If anyone objects to prepay or non-binding SLA flag now."
